# Failure Name

## Trigger

Name the alert, health state, stable category, and user-visible symptom.

## Containment

Protect data, tenant boundaries, cron, traffic, and recovery evidence.

## Diagnosis

Use request IDs and aggregate telemetry. Do not expose secrets or personal
content.

## Recovery

Use supported APIs and immutable artifacts. Never downgrade the database.

## Verification

List commands, tenant-hostname smoke tests, negative tests, and evidence.

## Escalation

Name the technical owner, business owner, severity, and communication path.
